parameters.name: AssociationId
parameters.description: The associate ID between the Express Connect Router (ECR) and the VBR.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the network instance to be uninstalled.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceRegionId
parameters.description: The region where the network instance resides.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceType
parameters.description: The type of the network instance. Valid values: **VBR**: virtual border router instance.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: performs a dry run without modifying the EPS resource. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits.
- **false** (default): sends a Normal request.

parameters.name: EcrId
parameters.description: The Express Connect Router (ECR) instance ID.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token for the next query. Valid values:
- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query or if no next query exists.
- If a next query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call.
